title: Mind the Gap: A survey of chronic wound datasets, methods, and clinical translation

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Mind the Gap: A survey of chronic wound datasets, methods, and clinical translation》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Chronic wounds, including diabetic foot ulcers, venous ulcers, arterial ulcers and pressure ulcers, represent a growing global health challenge with significant morbidity, mortality, and economic burden.

evidence.text: Chronic wounds, including diabetic foot ulcers, venous ulcers, arterial ulcers and pressure ulcers, represent a growing global health challenge with significant morbidity, mortality, and economic burden.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Mind the Gap: A survey of chronic wound datasets, methods, and clinical translation》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】Existing datasets are typically designed for algorithm benchmarking rather than clinical deployment, and therefore lack standardised acquisition protocols, scale calibration markers, depth information, detailed tissue composition annotations, and representation of diverse skin types.

evidence.text: Existing datasets are typically designed for algorithm benchmarking rather than clinical deployment, and therefore lack standardised acquisition protocols, scale calibration markers, depth information, detailed tissue composition annotations, and representation of diverse skin types.
